stanza: The first time I saw you
I knew it would never last
I'm not half what I wish I was
I don't think it'll ever pass
And I was bad news for you just because
I never meant to hurt you

partner.line: I don't think it'll ever pass

q.line: But it don't do no good to get angry
stanza: You can gaze out the window, get mad and get madder
Throw your hands in the air, say "What does it matter?"
But it don't do no good to get angry

partner.line: Throw your hands in the air, say "What does it matter?"

q.line: And when you say I seem angry, I get more angry
stanza: Every time you call me crazy, I get more crazy
And when you say I seem angry, I get more angry
